essence: World-born glory-natured wombing endless enjoyer-enjoyed; whatever pervades as great-light-formed: like the great common, Supreme-Śiva-formed.
Whatever form pervading only some differences: a category; as earth pervading all world-eggs.
Categories' cause-effect-ness shown; twofold.
Ultimate, and of emission.
Ultimate cause-effect: free agent-Lord's showing-forth with Śiva-to-earth body, non-different, resting in own nature.
Constructed cause-effect by Lord's will with necessity-breath; fixed before-after appearing; sprout from seed, wish, dream, pots.
Lord's agency never lapsing; unconstructed too the ultimate stands.
Wall-like standing ultimate; all drawn fits; assemblage alone caused-ness fitting.
All-being weave of free awareness; fixed own place-time-thing nature; deviation scales effect-difference.
Free-awareness Lord world-bodied maker of pots; potter-awareness nothing beyond; potter-pride Lord-made like pots.
Assemblage-doctrine strengthens awareness-alone makership.
On Meru no such pot would be.
Constructed caused-ness many-typed fits: dung worms, wish, mantra, herbs; scorpion-arising.
By own-system view the constructed shown.
Lord full with five powers; manifesting chiefly stands fivefold.
Awareness/bliss/will-led: Śiva/power/Sadāśiva; will even-acceptance; knowledge/action-led: Īśvara/knowledge.
Lords Śiva-Ananta; like Brahmā withdrawn; five pervasion-object particulars: pure path.
Directly Śiva maker; impure path Aghoreśa-Ananta emits for wavered atoms' enjoyment.
Waverer incomplete other-natured throbbing mere longing, future bounding-fitness: not impurity nor another category.
Passion-principle: action-bounded longing.
Action mere action; mind-nature passion varied by action-difference; distinction to be told.
Impurity: Lord's self-veiling wish; nothing else; earth-and-rest's thingness only thus.
Knowledge-kevalin impurity facing destruction fattens not action; dissolution-kevalin's yawning impurity-strengthened action causes transmigration-enjoyment.
For enjoyment-pierced atoms Aghoreśa emits; fittingly said; stirring by Lord-wish-force alone; inert by itself anywhere unable.
Atom: mere conscious-unconscious shining; conscious lordliness, unconscious impurity; emitting by Lord-wish-made; inert all-effect-pervading Māyā-principle material cause; Lord's Māyā-power distinct.
Kalā-to-earth too two-formedness to be described.
Gurus cited as proof of two-formedness.
What shines in resolve exists outside too, like a pot.
Māyā-kalā-sky-flowers too this course: purely affirmative reason.
Direct-realizers of Māyā-objects perfected indeed.
From Māyā-principle world-birth.
Non-sequential yet by stated view sequential appearing.
Per self the kalā-group divided.
Effect-makership found by self-difference; group may unite by wish like social selves; pure Lord-objected work-doers from world-opposition.
By power-descent sway becoming thus; to be told in its showing.
Impure opposite of that.
Māyā-born kalā yokes sleeping atom with slight makership; swelling, deforms Māyā not undeformable atom: her Māyā-effect-ness.
Mutual clinging: indistinguishable man-kalā inwardness.
Māyā-womb officers by grace at action-end: Māyā-man then kalā-man discriminations, stationed above.
Nature-man discrimination: below-the-chief non-transmigration.
Impurity-man discrimination: Śiva-likeness.
Man's fullness seen: Śiva-ness alone.
Kalā-principle alone slight-makership-giving, not —
makership of the unknowing.
Slight-knowing-giving impure knowledge from kalā; sees mind; grasps parts discriminately.
Quality-confused mind unable to grasp discriminately.
Mind-mirrored being discerned by knowledge.
Slight makership somewhere alone; passion's business in the part.
Not from dispassion; non-attachment seen even of dispassionate.
In dispassion duty and the rest attachment seen.
Sated in food yet inner passion unremoved.
Without it non-dispassion-non-arising contingency.
Time reckoning effect reckons bounded makership; in this sense necessity's business.
Her business; kalā-born fourfold; clinging I-do awareness gone to body-city-eight: beast.
Māyā-and-rest six called six sheaths.
Awareness set aside by Māyā; above-falling kalā stands sheath-like.
Slight Māyā-effect makership; but undistinguished to-be-qualified; engaged kalā births knowledge-and-rest.
Qualifier part called slight; kalā's apart-making emits enjoyed-common; pair-emission kalā-dependent.
Real path barren yet appearing sequential: both said.
Loving-knowing order varied; both directions seen.
Varied order in Raurava uncontradicted; stirred enjoyed-common: guṇa-principle.
Pleasure enjoyed-form-light lucidity; pain swing-formed action passion; delusion darkness.
Triad all enjoyed-formed.
Stirred chief yields effects, not unstirred.
Stirring assumed between; Sāṃkhya-seen separated guṇa.
Without lord-presiding, no fixed-man success.
From guṇa mind; man-light and object reflect.
In turbid mind-mirror non-self self-pride like silver in shell.
We keep I-feeling and makership; Sāṃkhya fits neither.
Pure I: non-rivalled wonder-formed deliberation.
I-maker's instrument-heap named.
Nature-heap threefold by guṇa difference.
Lucid begets mind and five senses with all-subtle-birth power.
Sense-powers prove I-maker-ness; regress bars extra instruments.
Two chief instruments knowledge/kalā; blind-lame I-ness; five action-senses; foot outer-seated; no break for crippled.
Going is action not grasping; Kaṇāda agrees; action-sense group admitted.
Pentad from joining-measure.
Five openings by five functions.
Hand-going is foot's doing; no sense-infinity.
Others: mind from rajasic.
Others: mind lucid-born, senses passionate-born.
Darkness-ruled I yields five knowable-formed subtle elements.
Pre-existent undistinguished common: sound-subtle.
Same account through smell.
Stirred sound-subtle gives space-room ether.
Stirred sound-subtle wind; sound needs ether.
Stirred form fire with two earlier.
Stirred taste waters with three earlier.
Stirred smell earth with four earlier.
Others derive ground from five.
Earth heap of qualities, no bearer.
Higher pervades; lower is pervaded.
Excellence needs lower; earth pervaded Śiva-down to water, up to power.

rasa.dominant: vicāra-śānta with adbhuta at scale (calm of reasoning, wonder at totality)
rasa.justification: The ahnika reasons — wall, potter, assemblage — and each proof lands as rest; wonder breaks through at the dung-to-scorpion variety (u13), the hundred-Rudra scale (u29-36), and the beast-definition (u54).

sections.FUNCTION: Establishes tattva-definition (whole vs partial pervasion), the two cause-effect-nesses (ultimate self-showing vs constructed willed order with sprout-seed-wish-dream proof), agency never lapsing, the wall simile, sāmagrī doctrine with deviation-scaling, the potter proof (Lord-maker, potter-pride Lord-made), Meru test, constructed variety (dung-to-scorpion), own-system five-power standing with five principles and pure-path lords, Aghoreśa-Ananta impure path for wavered atoms, craving vs impurity vs passion vs action distinctions, impurity as self-veiling wish, kevalin economics, atom-Māyā analysis (material cause vs distinct power), kalā-to-earth two-formedness with guru proof and pot rule, world-birth from Māyā with sequential-appearing, kalā-group purity, kalā's yoking-swelling-deforming, man-kalā clinging, grace discriminations to Śiva-ness, kañcuka economics (impure knowledge, confused mind, mirrored discernment, somewhere-makership, passion's part, dispassion debates, time-necessity, beast-definition, six sheaths, engaged kalā), enjoyed-common emission with barren-yet-appearing sequence, order-variety, guṇa natures, stirring-need with Sāṃkhya separated guṇa, presiding-need, mind/I-maker genesis with shell-silver simile against Sāṃkhya, pure I, heaps, lucid begetting, sense-proofs with regress bar, chief instruments with blind-lame I-ness and foot-seat, action-sense admission with Kaṇāda, pentad measure, five openings, hand-foot unity, others' views, darkness-ruled subtle elements, sound-subtle with pre-existent common, element births to earth-as-heap, and pervasion proof closing at power.
sections.KEY TERMS: tattva (partial pervasion); kāryakāraṇabhāva (pāramārthika/constructed); Kālī (implied ground); sāmagrī (assemblage; deviation-scaling); kumbhakāra (potter-proof); Meru-test; vṛścikodayavat (scorpion-arising variety); pañcaśakti (five powers); tattveśvara (lords); śuddhādhvā (pure path); Aghoreśa-Ananta (impure path); lolika (waverer); rāga/karma (bounded longing/mere action); mala (self-veiling wish); vijñānākala/pralayākala (starving/fueling kevalins); aṇu/Māyā-tattva vs Māyā-śakti (atom, material cause, distinct power); dvairūpya (two-formedness; pot proof; kevalānvayī); kalādivarga (pure/impure groups; śaktipāta); kañcukaṣaṭka (six sheaths; economies); bhogyasāmānya (enjoyed-common); kramavandhyā yet kramāvabhāsa (barren yet appearing); guṇa (pleasure/action/delusion natures); kṣobha (stirring need; Sāṃkhya separated); ahaṃkāra (shell-silver self-pride; anti-Sāṃkhya); śuddha vimarśa (pure I); karaṇaskandha/prakṛtiskandha (heaps); tanmātra/bhūta (subtle/gross births); pṛthivī (heap, no bearer); vyāpaka/vyāpya (pervasion proof).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Āhnika 8 gives the tattva-nature (tattvasvarūpa) after the seat/time/measurement ahnikas (a06–a07); kārya-kāraṇa and kañcuka doctrines recur in pratyabhijñā contexts; guṇa-to-bhūta ladder kin to Sāṃkhya (refuted on self). Witnesses: OccultGuide full translation, Pradīpaka word-by-word, Chakravarty/Bertagni English — parallels, not sources.
sections.EXPLANATION: The ahnika runs: (1) definitions — whole-pervasion Paramaśiva, partial-pervasion tattva with earth example, twofold cause-effect named; (2) ultimate vs constructed — Lord's self-showing body, willed fixed order with seed-wish-dream-pot proof, agency kept, wall simile; (3) sāmagrī — weave doctrine, deviation-scaling, potter proof with pride-dissolution, Meru test; (4) variety — dung-to-scorpion fitting, own-system promise, five-power standing, five principles with will-as-even-acceptance, pure-path lords; (5) impure path — Śiva-then-Aghoreśa, waverer analysis (longing not impurity), passion/action split, impurity-as-veiling-wish, kevalin economics, atom-Māyā analysis; (6) two-formedness — kalā-to-earth extension, guru proof, pot rule, sky-flowers, siddhas, world-birth, sequential-appearing, kalā-group purity; (7) kalā mechanics — yoking, swelling, deforming, clinging, grace discriminations to Śiva-ness, slight-makership limits, impure knowledge, confused mind, mirrored discernment, somewhere-makership, passion's part, dispassion debates, time-necessity, beast-definition, six sheaths, engaged kalā; (8) enjoyed-common — qualifier part, apart-making emission, barren-yet-appearing, order-variety, Raurava compatibility, guṇa natures, stirring-need; (9) mind genesis — presiding-need, guṇa-to-mind reflection, shell-silver self-pride, anti-Sāṃkhya I-keeping, pure I, heaps; (10) senses — lucid begetting, sense-proofs, regress bar, chief instruments, blind-lame I-ness, foot-seat, Kaṇāda admission, pentad, openings, hand-foot unity, others' views; (11) elements — darkness-ruled subtle elements, pre-existent sound-subtle common, same-through-smell, ether/wind/fire/waters/earth births, others' derivation, earth-as-heap, pervasion proof to power.
